overall_reason: The demo carries the AT avatar into the empty Assignee slot: it lifts with a shadow at 1613 ms, lands inside the ring by 2616 ms and holds that payoff to the end of the 6 s window, with movement ending at 1917 ms and no snaps.

score.reason: T-POSTER and T-DEMO-LOOP pass because the payoff (the avatar in the slot) holds from 2616 ms on, and T-CONTINUITY finds no snaps; no cursor or hand drives the drag, so the cause of the move is only implied.

findings.where: passive recording, the AT avatar moving into the Assignee slot, 1440
findings.evidence: The stills at 415, 901, 1613 and 2616 ms show the avatar lifting and travelling into the slot with no cursor or touch point anywhere in the frame; the composition declares no transitions, so the move is script-driven.
findings.before: The avatar lifts and travels by itself.
findings.after: Show the pointer that grabs the avatar and keep it at a fixed grab offset through the drop (MOT-270), or show the change as an assignment without a drag.
findings.why: A drag with no hand reads as the object moving itself, so the viewer cannot tell who made the assignment.

strengths: The payoff holds: the avatar sits in the slot from 2616 ms to the end of the 6 s window, so the poster frame (fold-1440.png) shows the result.
The drop target stays put while the avatar travels (MOT-270), and the passive recording reports no snaps.
